listing.aiSummary: Adds militarized variants of pirate ships and weapons, along with new hullmods.

description: Adds more-militarized weapons of pirate mk2 ships, and a couple "what-if?" weapons. Not balanced and i didn't even attempt. Ships added: - Atlas mk2 (II) - Colossus mk3 (II) - Mudskipper mk2 (II) They have more armor, more OP and militarized reactors, but very little storage, and less acceleration. They are added as Independent ships, not pirate! Weapon variants added: - Devastator Cannon: version without range issues, version with regenerating charges, and version with both. - Hellbore Cannon: proximity shell version (Reaper sized explosion). - Plasma Cannon: single shot version. - HAG: version that deals less direct damage, but some guaranteed armor damage. Hullmods added: - High Spectal Amplifier: same as HSA, but also +100% to all beam PD deapon damage. - Auxiliary Ablative Armor: turns ship armor ablative, for a lot of OP. Weaker than Invictus's armor but also isn't quite as weak to AP. - Rapid Phase Coils: Feel like Sierra on steroids. x5 speed while phased. x4 phase flux usage. Cruisers and Capitals only. - Advanced Weapon Support: +75% damage and +300 range for weapons that go on slots bigger than the weapon.

discordPostHtml:
Adds more-militarized weapons of pirate mk2 ships, and a couple "what-if?" weapons.
Not balanced and i didn't even attempt.

Ships added:
- Atlas mk2 (II)
- Colossus mk3 (II)
- Mudskipper mk2 (II)
They have more armor, more OP and militarized reactors, but very little storage, and less acceleration. They are added as Independent ships, not pirate!

Weapon variants added:
- Devastator Cannon: version without range issues, version with regenerating charges, and version with both.
- Hellbore Cannon: proximity shell version (Reaper sized explosion).
- Plasma Cannon: single shot version.
- HAG: version that deals less direct damage, but some guaranteed armor damage.

Hullmods added:
- High Spectal Amplifier: same as HSA, but also +100% to all beam PD deapon damage.
- Auxiliary Ablative Armor: turns ship armor ablative, for a lot of OP. Weaker than Invictus's armor but also isn't quite as weak to AP.
- Rapid Phase Coils: Feel like Sierra on steroids. x5 speed while phased. x4 phase flux usage. Cruisers and Capitals only.
- Advanced Weapon Support: +75% damage and +300 range for weapons that go on slots bigger than the weapon.

Download: https://github.com/PrincessOfEvil/Independent-Interstellar/archive/refs/tags/0.4.4.zip
Image:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrincessOfEvil/Independent-Interstellar/master/graphics/mudskipper.png
